Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm

Package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools.provider

package hibernate.jakarta.persistence.tools.provider
Service Provider Interface (SPI) implementations for Jakarta Persistence via Hibernate ORM 6.

This package contains the ServiceLoader provider and factory implementations supporting the "jakarta" persistence namespace:

  • HibernatePersistenceServiceProvider – abstract base provider binding the "jakarta" namespace.
  • HibernatePersistenceLinterFactory – abstract base linter factory binding the "jakarta" namespace.
  • HibernateEnhancerProvider – service provider for EnhancerProvider.
  • HibernateNamedObjectParserFactory – service provider for NamedObjectParserFactory.
  • HibernateSchemaValidatorFactory – service provider for SchemaValidatorFactory.
